rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The President of the House of Councillors (長田裕二) reports a notice received that day from Prime Minister Kaifu (海部内閣総理大臣) that the Cabinet had decided to resign en masse that day, given under article 64 of the Diet Act.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The House of Councillors' first ballot (245 votes, majority 123) gives 宮澤喜一 115, 田邊誠 75, 石田幸四郎 20, 不破哲三 14, 星川保松 11 and 大内啓伍 10, with no majority; in the runoff (244 votes) 宮澤喜一 has 115, 田邊誠 85 and 44 are blank, and the House designates 宮澤喜一.
